name: Point & Portal
summary: Action at a distance through portals placed by pointing, like Point & Teleport: instead of moving the user, a portal opens near the pointed location so distant or occluded objects can be reached and operated with the hand.
howItWorks: Using Quest Pro controllers, the user points with a teleport-style arc to place a portal at a distant location, including beyond line of sight, and interacts through it within arm's reach; portals stay level and can be kept as persistent alternatives to teleporting. In a study pressing non-occluded and occluded buttons, Point & Portal was faster than Point & Teleport when obstacles were present, with lower cognitive load, less physical movement and fewer pointing actions, and was preferred.
advantages: Familiar pointing interaction from Point & Teleport.

relationships.note: Earlier portal technique for remote target acquisition.

review.notes: Coded from the ISMAR 2023 full text. Borderline: action at a distance mixed with navigation; the baseline (Point & Teleport) is a navigation technique.
